verdict.rationale: Notion's marketing mentions AI agents ("Keep work moving 24/7 with agents") and instant Q&A with citations, and the API/developer platform (notion-docs-5) could theoretically support building custom automations, but the evidence pack has no concrete documentation of a UI or workflow for configuring a custom AI agent's persona, tools, or triggers. Missing for 10: detailed agent-builder documentation, examples of custom agent configuration (tools, triggers, permissions), and independent/hands-on confirmation that users can actually build bespoke agents rather than just use built-in AI features.
